sentence_stem: Although the old house had stood empty for decades,
correct_completion: its windows still glowed faintly at dusk.
full_sentence: Although the old house had stood empty for decades, its windows still glowed faintly at dusk.
acceptable_variants: a faint light still flickered in one of its upper rooms.

options.text: because it was built by a famous architect.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' signals cause and clashes with 'although', which signals contrast.

options.text: so the villagers had long since forgotten it.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, not a contrast with the empty house.

options.text: its windows still glowed faintly at dusk.
it was full of dust and broken furniture.
options.why_wrong: This continues the description of emptiness rather than contrasting with it.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' (contrast between the two clauses)
explanation: After 'although', the second clause must contrast with the first. An empty house is expected to be dark and lifeless, so a clause showing signs of life creates the contrast. Learners may be tempted to use a cause connector here because of a similar-looking connector in their first language, but 'although' always signals concession.
translation: Aunque la vieja casa llevaba décadas vacía, sus ventanas aún brillaban tenuemente al anochecer.
